increment_paragraph: **W48-BU-SINGLE-LEAF-BODIES (2026-10-23; resumed after the round-1 halt).** The [card](../../reports/w48-bu-single-leaf-bodies/README.md) adds gateway rule 35. A `*` applied to a string literal that is only read is constant data to the lexical access gate (librdkafka's `rd_assert(!*"...")`, `RD_NOTREACHED`, `RD_BUG`). An array member decayed at an admissible W44 call actual is rule 14c's `&PATH[0]`, only for a one-dimensional unqualified builtin-scalar array, with every root premise unchanged. Its prediction was committed after the first semantic commit and before any measurement; the report states this order. On the scheduler card's eight-home corpus route, the TIP measured against its own arms-off control moves exactly 12 rows Unknown→Safe: ten through the literal arm (all eight predicted sole-leaf rows, a two-line assert and one in-unit caller through a summary) and two through the decay arm (`rd_kafka_log_print`, `mk_config_signature`). BASE 4dd8c8013 → TIP reads 977→999 Safe and 3,848→3,826 Unknown, with 9 provisional Unsafe unchanged; the other +10 are sibling rules 32 (8) and 34 (2). No Safe regresses, leaks stay 40 and every null verdict is unchanged. Combined Safe rises 851→859, and no rule-35 row moves under any runtime scenario. System (99 Safe) and the tail-pause slice (57 Safe) keep every status. Of the twelve brief bodies only `rd_kafka_mock_cluster_io_set_event` is freed. XXH32/XXH64_digest_endian are a prediction miss: the decayed member in a whole-return call is not read. Run 4 failed on path spelling after the checkout move; run 5 measured through byte-identical inputs whose compile databases are re-spelled, and its BASE reproduces 977 Safe exactly. QCore.LiteralDecayReadings has 14 audited theorems.
